text:
Samir Patel: FYI escalation from Acme Analytics via Zendesk #4521 — dashboard legends don't match series, tooltips on mobile show wrong counts, and ~24h of metrics missing. Customer reports started 2026-03-16 22:30 UTC. Marked P1 by CS. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/acme/4521/screen1.png

Alex Chen: Ack. Can you post repro steps + device info and any request ids?

Samir Patel: Repro steps I got from customer:
1) Login to Console (org: acme)
2) Open "Request metrics" dashboard
3) Time range: Last 24 hours
4) On desktop legend shows 3 series (total_req, cached_req, failed_req) but colors don't align to lines; on mobile tooltip shows counts from previous day.
5) Missing data for 00:00–04:00 UTC in the chart.

They also sent console logs and a HAR. Key API call: `GET /api/metrics?org=acme&range=24h&group=series`
Example partial response:
```json
{"series":[{"seriesId":"total_req","points":[[1710660000,123],[1710663600,140]]},
{"seriesId":"cached_req","points":[[1710660000,30],[1710663600,45]]},
{"seriesId":"failed_req","points":[[1710660000,2],[1710663600,3]]}],"meta":{"tz":"UTC"}}
```

Morgan Lee: Looking. Quick hunch: our chart color/legend mapping currently uses index-based assignment. If backend occasionally reorders `series` (or strips empty series) we can get color/legend mismatches. Mobile tooltip bug could be bisect index off-by-one when chart width < ~300px. Also, delayed metrics gap smells like ingestion/replica lag.

Samir Patel: Request IDs from the customer's session: `r-8f3a1b`, `r-8f3a2c`, `r-8f3a3d`. Customer device: iPhone 13, iOS 16, Safari. HAR indicates the API responded with a slightly different series order for one of the calls.

Tia Gomez: I checked ingestion pipelines. There's a DB replica lag on EU-metrics cluster between 2026-03-16 22:10–23:05 UTC — write queue backed up during a deploy, looks like ~50k points delayed. That explains the missing 00:00–04:00 UTC window for that org (their reporting timezone + UTC window aligns). We'll need to backfill from primary.

Alex Chen: Proposed action plan:
- Frontend hotfix: use stable series identifier (`seriesId`) to map colors/legend instead of relying on array index. (Owner: Morgan)
- Tooltip fix: add bisect bounds check for narrow charts to avoid off-by-one mismatches. (Owner: Morgan)
- Observability/infra: patch replica lag and run backfill for EU cluster. (Owner: Tia + infra)
- Customer comms: give workaround (use desktop or set absolute time range earlier than 24h) and ETA (6 hours). (Owner: Lena/Alex)

Morgan Lee: I'll open a PR and put the legend behavior behind a feature flag `stable-legend-v1` for quick rollback if needed. PR: https://git.redwood/pull/9876. Fix snippet:
```js
// prefer stable id when assigning palette
const key = series.seriesId || index
palette.assign(key, series.colorHint)
```
I'll also add a unit test to ensure color mapping stays stable when series are reordered.

Tia Gomez: We're kicking off the backfill now. ETA for caught-up metrics ~3 hours if no further DB interruptions. Patch to replication config rolling out in 30m.

Lena Ortiz: Told customer we're investigating, offered workaround and ETA 6 hours. They asked for daily updates; they've accepted the workaround for now. Zendesk ticket updated: https://zendesk.redwood/tickets/4521.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20260316-03 (priority: P1 for enterprise customer).

Alex Chen: I'll own external comms and escalate to account team. Morgan, once PR is merged to staging, please post staging link and a short demo so CS can validate with the customer.

Morgan Lee: Deployed hotfix to staging. Tests pass. Staging link: https://staging.console.redwood/orgs/acme/dashboards/request-metrics. Please validate on an iPhone emulator.

Samir Patel: CS confirmed staging looks correct on desktop and mobile emulator. Planning production deploy after backfill completes and we confirm no regressions. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Rolling to prod in 2h behind `stable-legend-v1` flag. Will monitor metrics and rollback if any issues.

Samir Patel: Keep updates here.

Lena Ortiz: I'll send a summary update to the customer now and set expectation for next update in 3 hours.

Morgan Lee: One more note — adding a migration to standardize `seriesId` in older metric payloads so backfilled points have stable ids. I'll include that in the PR.

Samir Patel: Great. Closing the loop for now, will update thread when prod deploy + backfill complete.
